To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the architecture framework for automated vehicles (AFV) can serve as an integrated development tool for the development of safe automated vehicles.
the capability-based assessment of automated vehicles is a promising approach for a holistic safety analysis of automated vehicles.
the system safety of automated vehicles can be assessed in a holistic manner by using a capability-based safety analysis approach.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the question, how to structure the development of an automated vehicle system with respect to its system safety.
the question how safety requirements are derived from system functions and can be traced back in the system development process.
the development of a holistic architecture framework for automated vehicles that supports a safe development process and enables traceability of emergents system properties.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the proposed framework can be used to derive safety requirements for the development of safe automated vehicles.
the proposed approach enables the derivation of behavioral safety requirements for automated vehicles and their integration in an architecture framework.

an integrated systems engineering approach for automated vehicle systems requires the consideration of several viewpoints and the description of correspondences between these viewpoints in order to enable holistic systems engineering and traceability of emergents system properties like system safety.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the proposed framework provides an architecture framework which is capable of supporting a holistic systems engineering of safe automated vehicle systems.
the presented framework provides a basis for a structured development of safe automated vehicles.
the presented approach provides a holistic view on a vehicle system and enables traceability of safety properties throughout the development process.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a system's perspective on safety can enable traceability of safety requirements to the architecture of a system and thus provide a basis for holistic safety assurance.
a capability-based safety analysis can be used to assess the safety of an automated vehicle.
a systems approach is needed to assess the safety of automated vehicle systems.
